_comment: The music the game starts to: over the intro and the main screen, until the player is in a game or puts the radio
on (Audio/StartMusic.cs). It plays on the radio's bus, so the radio's volume is its volume. The file is Lame Genie's
cover of the Street Rod 2 intro, used with the band's permission (credits.csv); optional, so a mod that drops it starts quiet.
